title: 第22章 收获
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
送走曹凌薇，齐云溪搬了张凳子返回修炼室，坐到石榻前。

    苏牧微微偏头看去道：“辛苦了，昨晚等了一夜，担心坏了吧？”

    齐云溪摇头笑道：“不辛苦，我不累。”

    她将垂在脸颊的一缕发丝捋到耳后，又无意识地理了理毯子，颤着睫毛犹豫了会，问出了心中的疑惑。

    “牧师兄，到底怎么回事啊，执法殿怎会认为你是凶手，没有证据，他们就对你用刑吗？”

    苏牧看着她，迟疑一瞬道：“是陈旭飞，得知你我婚约，心生嫉恨，作伪证污蔑我。”

    齐云溪一怔，眼中闪过一丝慌乱，忙道：“对不起牧师兄，我…我…他怎么能这样？都是我的错，是我连累了你……”

    见她满脸自责，苏牧对视道：“你有什么错，如实告诉你，是要你知道，人心险恶，此番遭遇，也不过是你开始真正了解我的冰山一角，因为，李构确实是我杀的。”

    齐云溪呆住，随即俏脸一紧，连忙起身跑出去关门，返回又将修炼室的石门也关了，并接连打下三道隔绝禁制。

    苏牧看着她的一举一动，笑道：“不必惊慌，此事彻底过去了。”

    齐云溪暗自松了口气，坐回凳子上道：“我听温师弟说，那李构不是炼气九层的内门核心弟子吗？还是望月峰峰主的亲传弟子，师兄如何杀的了他？”

    苏牧默了默道：“过程就不说了，类似的事情在我身上发生不少，今后跟了我，你要有心理准备。”

    齐云溪用力点头，眼神坚定道：“我做好准备了！”

    苏牧想挪动身子，不小心牵动伤口，剑眉蹙了下。

    齐云溪连忙躬身站起，关切道：“很疼吧？”

    苏牧咧嘴笑道：“确实有点。”

    齐云溪掖了掖毯子道：“那不说话了，师兄先休息，睡着就不觉得疼了。”

    苏牧便闭上了眼睛，却并未马上睡觉休息，而是在脑海里复盘，从那晚在废丹房外遭遇李构和林语山的私会开始……

    其实，他并非一个墨守成规、安分守己的人，所谓的低调稳健，也不过是在人前伪装的一层迷惑性外衣。

    活到现在四十岁，他一路走来的经历也算得上丰富精彩、惊心动魄，一次次频繁出任务涉险境，为了资源干过杀人越货的勾当，为了珍贵灵药，敢于冒险豁得出去……

    但这一次，短短不到一个月的时间，虽然曲折险象环生，却给他带来了无以轮比的创收，为接下来的修行之路奠定了大好的基础。

    首先，触发了金手指，识海空间多了一片坟墓，可以吞噬尸体转化能量提高修为。
content_en:
After sending Cao Lingwei away, Qi Yunxi moved a stool back to the training room and sat in front of the stone couch.

    Su Mu turned his head slightly and said, "Thank you for your hard work. You waited all night last night. Are you worried?"

    Qi Yunxi shook his head and smiled: "It's not hard, I'm not tired."

    She tucked a strand of hair hanging on her face behind her ears, straightened the blanket unconsciously, hesitated for a moment with fluttering eyelashes, and asked the doubts in her heart.

    "Brother Pastor, what's going on? How could the Law Enforcement Hall think you are the murderer? Will they torture you without evidence?"

    Su Mu looked at her, hesitated for a moment and said, "It's Chen Xufei. When he learned about our engagement, he became jealous and committed perjury to slander me."

    Qi Yunxi was startled, with a trace of panic flashing in his eyes, and said hurriedly: "I'm sorry, brother pastor, I...I...how could he do this? It's all my fault, I caused you trouble..."

    Seeing her face filled with self-blame, Su Mu looked at each other and said, "What's wrong with you? I tell you the truth. I want you to know that people's hearts are sinister. This encounter is just the tip of the iceberg for you to truly understand me, because I did kill Li Gou."

    Qi Yunxi was stunned, and then his pretty face tightened. He quickly got up and ran out to close the door. When he returned, he also closed the stone door of the training room and placed three isolation restrictions in succession.

    Su Mu watched her every move and said with a smile: "Don't panic, this matter is completely over."

    Qi Yunxi secretly breathed a sigh of relief, sat back on the stool and said, "I heard from Junior Brother Wen, isn't Li Gou a core disciple of the inner sect at the ninth level of Qi Refining? He is also a direct disciple of the master of Wangyue Peak. How did Senior Brother kill him?"

    Su Mu was silent and said: "I won't go into the process. Similar things have happened to me a lot. If you follow me in the future, you must be mentally prepared."

    Qi Yunxi nodded vigorously and said with firm eyes: "I'm ready!"

    Su Mu wanted to move, but accidentally touched the wound, and frowned.

    Qi Yunxi quickly stood up and said with concern: "Does it hurt?"

    Su Mu grinned and said, "A little bit indeed."

    Qi Yunxi tucked up the blanket and said, "No more talking then. Senior brother, rest first. You won't feel any pain when you fall asleep."

    Su Mu closed his eyes, but did not go to sleep immediately. Instead, he replayed in his mind the secret meeting between Li Gou and Lin Yushan outside the Waste Pill Room that night...

    In fact, he is not a stickler for rules and a law-abiding person. The so-called low-key and stable person is just a confusing coat disguised in front of others.

    He is now forty years old, and his experiences along the way can be considered rich, exciting, and thrilling. He frequently went on missions and faced dangerous situations, committed murder and smuggling for resources, and dared to take risks for precious elixirs...

    But this time, in less than a month, despite the twists and turns and dangers, it brought him unparalleled income and laid a good foundation for the next path of spiritual practice.

    First of all, the golden finger is triggered, and there is an extra tomb in the sea of ​​​​consciousness space, which can swallow corpses, convert energy, and improve cultivation.
